subject: CS478
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The topic 'Video Display and Flicker Fusion' had no eligible Arabic candidates, as the only relevant video found was in English. Selections prioritize direct relevance to the topic's core concepts, educational clarity, and peer validation through view counts. For the Arabic CRT topic, a highly-viewed teardown video was chosen over a more relevant but low-view animation that failed the view count gate.

coverage.note: No eligible candidates found. The only shortlisted video was in English, failing the language gate.

videos.title: Images, Pixels and RGB
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed Code.org video provides a foundational explanation of how images are represented by pixels and RGB values, perfectly matching the topic.

videos.title: Bitmap Images
videos.filter_reason: This video is perfectly on-topic, explicitly explaining how resolution and color depth affect image quality and file size, which is key to calculating memory requirements.

videos.title: What is the Frame Rate of the Human Eye?
videos.filter_reason: An excellent deep-dive that directly addresses the biological limits of the human eye's perception of frame rates and its relationship to flicker fusion.

videos.title: CRT | Cathode Ray Tube Display | CG | Computer Graphics | Lec-05 | Bhanu Priya
videos.filter_reason: This is a comprehensive academic lecture that clearly explains the components and working principles of a CRT, making it ideal for university-level understanding.

videos.title: Monitors Explained - LCD, LED, OLED, CRT, TN, IPS, VA
videos.filter_reason: This exceptionally well-animated video directly compares multiple display technologies, including detailed explanations of how both LCD and OLED work, making it a perfect fit.

videos.title: درس في البكسل وانظمة الالوان للصور الرقمية في الحاسوب  / المعلم احمد شحاده
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a solid foundational lesson on pixels and how digital images are represented in a computer, including how to calculate their size.

videos.title: تقنية رقمية 2 :  العمق اللوني | الدقة | البكسل | أنظمة اللون
videos.filter_reason: This is the most comprehensive choice, as its title and content explicitly cover the key metrics of color depth, resolution, and pixels for a thorough explanation.

videos.title: شاهد ماذا يوجد داخل شاشة التلفزيون CRT ؟
videos.filter_reason: This practical teardown video shows and explains the internal components of a CRT, helping to demystify its physical construction and function for students.
